method: Exact multiset order and legal rotation enumeration; first rotation normalized to zero; native boundary/collision/node-join rules; representative aesthetics are a heuristic, not user approval.
constraints: No changed stats, prices, genes, grades or set bonuses.
Remapped shapes pass geometry only and require catalog/migration work before game use.
No level-three/four assignment is decided before level two.
